summary: Bring the canonical generated command layout, safe metadata cache, bounded HTTP reads, and accurate download failures to public.
reason: The public CLI used a shared temporary cache and could claim a successful font download after a read or write failure. Its monolithic command source also left the published build and command documentation out of sync.
validated_outcome: Offline Go tests cover cache safety, bounded responses, command-level read, size, and file-write failures, safe output names from remote metadata, and source and release version behavior; vet, build, skill verification, release-ledger guard, JSON validation, and diff checks pass without a Google Fonts request.
